rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for a respected political figure involved in national or international affairs.

example.english: This statesman has always put people's livelihoods first.
example.traditional: 呢位政治家一向以民生為先。
example.jyutping: ne1 wai6 zing3 zi6 gaa1 jat1 hoeng3 ji5 man4 saang1 wai4 sin1

rows.note: Use this for the national-leader slice, especially a head of government or state.

example.english: The statesman announced a new policy.
example.traditional: 國家領導人宣布新政策。
example.jyutping: gwok3 gaa1 ling5 dou6 jan4 syun1 bou3 san1 zing3 caak3

rows.note: Use this when the person is being described specifically as a leader on the international stage.

example.english: Countries around the world are hoping this statesman will step in to mediate.
example.traditional: 各國都期待呢位國際領袖出面斡旋。
example.jyutping: gok3 gwok3 dou1 kei4 doi6 ne1 wai6 gwok3 zai3 ling5 zau6 ceot1 min2 waat3 syun4
